boundaries.name: abi_storage_widths
boundaries.obligation: Canonical bounded ABI/storage words, mapping defaults, fixed arrays and Solidity panic/error encoding; Nat projection is not compiler refinement.

boundaries.name: external_exact_call_semantics
boundaries.obligation: External observations correspond to exact configured contracts, verifier target/proof bytes, ordered staticcalls/transfers/balance reads. Returned ERC20 contract address is retained for both balance reads and payout. Native token0 balance denotes ETH, and pull dispatch denotes Rollup.withdraw/withdrawToken. ABI decoding and failed/malformed balance observations remain explicit obligations.

boundaries.name: evm_rollback_reentrancy
boundaries.obligation: EVM reverts roll back all state and external effects, callbacks observe specified CEI state and all entrypoints enforce intended modifiers; gas/resources unmodeled.

boundaries.name: proof_authority_and_pooled_ownership
boundaries.obligation: External proof verification soundness, authenticated signed head, finalized registry/amount provenance and channel ownership within pooled Rollup custody are not established by this model.

boundaries.name: outputs_events_projection
boundaries.obligation: The model projects manager storage changes and ordered calls; event encoding and scalar return ABI are not compiler-refined.

boundaries.name: untranslated_manager_lifecycle
boundaries.obligation: Constructor, participant identity proof, close proof composition, pending/finalize/challenge transition bodies and partial withdrawal bodies remain untranslated in this module.
